runs.text:
Blood of the Nations is the twelfth studio album by German heavy metal band Accept. It is the band's first studio recording since 1996's Predator and the first album to feature vocalist Mark Tornillo and drummer Stefan Schwarzmann. It is the first Accept album without Udo Dirkschneider on lead vocals since Eat the Heat, and the band's first album to feature guitarist Herman Frank since Balls to the Wall.
